items.text: What is known about pharmacy technicians performing medication reconciliation at care transitions, including tasks, training and supervision models, accuracy measures, reported outcomes and regulatory scope?
items.population: Pharmacy technicians (regulated or unregulated) and the patients whose medicines they reconcile
items.concept: Medication reconciliation tasks performed by technicians, with training, supervision, accuracy measures, outcomes and permitted scope
items.context: Admission, transfer and discharge in hospitals, including rural hospitals, any country, from 2000

finer: Feasible with one pharmacist and library support if a second reviewer is released; interesting to the committee; novel as a map of discharge roles; ethical with no participants; relevant to the April decision.
summary: One PCC question for the scoping review.
